blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.

Today, venture into Soberanía National Park, one of the most accessible areas in Central America for observing wildlife in its natural surroundings.

Board a boat and explore Gatun Lake, the vast man-made lake at the heart of the Panama Canal. As you navigate through its waters, keep an eye out for monkeys, iguanas, caimans, turtles and other wildlife, while also witnessing vessels making their way through the Canal.  

The experience also includes visits to several ecological exhibits, including orchid, butterfly and frog nurseries, as well as a sloth rescue centre, offering a closer look at the remarkable biodiversity of the region.

Later this afternoon, transfer to Albrook Domestic Airport for your flight to David, capital of Chiriquí Province. Upon arrival, continue by private transfer to your hotel in Boquete.
